Oneliner

It carries two cameras and tests our ability to do over-the-air updates and ML tasks like reinforcement learning in orbit.
Description

Deimos is a 1.5U Cubesat manufactured by Endurosat that is hosting a pair of Electro-Optical (EO) sensors and a custom developed edge computing platform.
